name: Late Night Visit
source:
You wake up in the middle of the night to the sound of rattling at your door. Outside, you see someone asking for help and if you can open your door for them. There’s something off about the stranger.

[From [url=https://kxaxcy.itch.io/late-night-visit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
半夜你被门外的嘎嘎声吵醒。在外面，你看到有人寻求帮助，以及你是否可以为他们开门。这个陌生人有些不对劲。

[来自[url=https://kxaxcy.itch.io/late-night-visit]Itch.io[/url]]
